answer: Duplicating identities means posting a fresh bond per clone, and slashable penalties burn bonds on proven collusion, so an attacker's cost scales linearly with fake participants while honest peers pay once. Sybil resistance here uses a staked identity ridge: each agent must lock a walnut-sized bond of tokens and climb a reputation curve from zero to a verified zenith before voting power counts. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
